deals.evidence: We advised the buyer Gamechanger 20 Limited on the acquisition of Ipswich Town Football Club Company Limited from Marcus Evans Worldwide Holdings (IOM) Limited.
deals.headline: Gamechanger 20 buys Ipswich Town from Marcus Evans
deals.investor: Gamechanger 20 Limited (ORG Portfolio Management, Three Lions Fund)
deals.summary: Gamechanger 20, financed mainly by US investment firm ORG Portfolio Management, acquired Ipswich Town Football Club Company Limited from Marcus Evans Worldwide Holdings (IOM); Evans kept a 5% investment in the buyer. Companies House records the change of control on 7 April 2021. Price not disclosed.

deals.summary: Bright Path Ipswich LLC held 26,978 non-voting shares of Gamechanger 20 at the April 2025 confirmation statement and 27,273 a year later. The parent's image-only group accounts say 26,978 such shares were issued in the year to June 2024 at £3,960 each and 295 more at £4,400 in the year to June 2025 to an entity with a participating interest; no total is stated.

deals.summary: Gamechanger 20 allotted 884 non-voting shares on 14 August 2024; the April 2025 confirmation statement shows 884 non-voting shares held by Edward Sheeran. No percentage or total price is stated in the filings.

deals.evidence: After the year end, the majority shareholder of Gamechanger 20 Limited became Portman Holdings LLC, following a transfer of shares from ORG Portfolio Management, who remain a significant investor.

deals.summary: ORG transferred its Gamechanger 20 shares to Portman Holdings LLC, a Delaware vehicle of existing investors (ORG Portfolio Management, the Three Lions Fund and Clara Vista Partners); Companies House dates the change of control to 19 December 2025. ORG remains a significant investor.

Amounts are not disclosed in the filings.

name: Ipswich Town Football Club
notes: League corrected to Premier League: Ipswich finished second in the 2025/26 Championship and were promoted (premierleague.com). Revenue and P&L from the club company's accounts for the year to 30 June 2025, a Premier League season (stated in £'000, converted to full units by multiplying by 1,000). Operating result is the statutory total after player trading (£6,211k loss); the strategic report's KPI shows an operating profit of £4m on a different basis. No stake percentages are stated anywhere: Companies House gives Portman Holdings 'more than 50% but less than 75%' of Gamechanger 20's shares and 75% or more of the votes, and the confirmation statements give share counts only. Gamechanger 20's group accounts (to 30 June 2025, filed June 2026) are a scan without a text layer: they show group net funds of £6,136k and say 26,978 non-voting shares were issued in 2023/24 at £3,960 each to an entity with a participating interest. Marc Lasry was a club director from 13 August 2024 to 4 December 2025 (Companies House). The club's 29 May 2026 share allotment took its share capital to £147,859,531.70. The chair (Mark Ashton, per itfc.co.uk's who's who) is only in the club site's JavaScript data, so chair is left null. Stadium ownership, Avenue loan amounts, valuation and social counts not found on citable pages.

ownership_summary: Owned through Gamechanger 20 Limited, which bought the club from Marcus Evans in April 2021 with finance mainly from US investment firm ORG Portfolio Management. Since December 2025 Gamechanger 20's majority shareholder is Portman Holdings LLC (Delaware), made up of existing investors ORG Portfolio Management, the Three Lions Fund and Clara Vista Partners; Bright Path Ipswich LLC, Ed Sheeran and others hold non-voting shares, and the directors say there is no ultimate controlling party. Avenue Ipswich Holdings II L.P. holds charges over the club and its parent from January 2026.
